desc: The versatile third rack was redesigned to load more than just silverware with additional space for unique items..Ensure a deep clean for tall items, narrow glasses, jars and more thanks to this dishwasher with bottle jets. 4 powerful jets direct water and detergent inside to effectively wash hard-to-reach areas..34 H x 23 3/4 W x 24 D
